versions.changelog:
- Updated documentation to use `<skill-dir>` placeholder in command paths instead of absolute examples.
- Improved instructions for better portability across install locations.
- No code changes or new features—documentation only.

- Initial release of photo-capture skill.
- Capture fresh webcam photos on macOS, Windows, or Linux using direct ffmpeg access.
- No dependency on screen-recording, accessibility, or UI automation permissions.
- Saves captured images to the workspace `tmp/` folder and replies with the image path.
- Provides fallback to macOS app-window screenshot only if direct capture fails.
